text.en: Enjoy the quiet. If anyone asks, we discussed the weather.
text.zh-CN: 享受这片刻安静吧。如果有人问起，就说我们在聊天气。

text.en: Rochefort wants the ledger, Milady. And the names you copied.
text.zh-CN: 米莱狄，罗什福尔要那本账册，还有你抄下的名字。

text.en: Five armed men for a lady's reading notes. How flattering.
text.zh-CN: 为了女士的读书笔记，竟来了五个带剑的男人。真抬举我。

text.en: You can settle your reading habits without threatening the caravan.
text.zh-CN: 你们的阅读纠纷，用不着拿整个商队来解决。

text.en: I need to regroup. Those guards aren't here to negotiate.
text.zh-CN: 得先整备一下。这些卫兵可不是来谈判的。

text.en: Milady de Winter. An excellent entrance, traveler. Let's put it to use.
text.zh-CN: 米莱狄·德温特。旅人，你登场得很漂亮。别浪费这份本事。

text.en: What did you read that was worth five swords?
text.zh-CN: 什么笔记，值得别人动用五把剑？

text.en: Payments. Names. Things powerful men prefer to forget. Rochefort's holding my courier at the Cardinal's Tower.
text.zh-CN: 款项、人名，还有大人物希望忘掉的事。罗什福尔把我的信使关在枢机塔。

text.en: I'll help get the courier out. That doesn't make me part of your schemes.
text.zh-CN: 我可以帮忙救人，但别把我算进你的阴谋里。

text.en: Of course. We have a common interest. For now, that's more useful than trust.
text.zh-CN: 当然。我们利益相同。目前，这比信任更管用。

text.en: I'll travel with you. Take this Threefold Swordplay Manual. Even a useful ally needs practice.
text.zh-CN: 我和你一起走。这本三段剑术手册拿着。有用的盟友，也得练习。

text.en: No visitors. No messages. And absolutely no musketeers.
text.zh-CN: 不见访客，不收口信。尤其不欢迎火枪手。

text.en: D'Artagnan. Still rushing into other people's affairs?
text.zh-CN: 达达尼昂，又急着插手别人的事？

text.en: You locked up a courier for carrying a letter. I'd call that an invitation.
text.zh-CN: 你把一个送信的人关了起来。我就当这是给我的请帖。

text.en: Milady sent us. I'm beginning to suspect she left out a few details.
text.zh-CN: 米莱狄让我们来救人。我开始怀疑她漏讲了不少细节。

text.en: She usually does. Get me past these guards; I'll bring the courier out.
text.zh-CN: 她向来如此。替我挡住守卫，我去把信使带出来。

text.en: The prisoner stays. Guards, make sure our guests understand.
text.zh-CN: 囚犯留下。卫兵，让客人们听明白。

text.en: Rescue first. Explanations afterward.
text.zh-CN: 先救人，解释留到之后。

text.en: You've freed one messenger. You haven't silenced the names in that ledger.
text.zh-CN: 你们放走了一个信使，可账册上的名字不会就此消失。

text.en: The courier is safe. I'll see him clear of the tower. Keep these training guides; you've earned them.
text.zh-CN: 信使安全了。我送他离开塔楼。这些教材给你，你值得这份谢礼。

text.en: And Rochefort? He doesn't look ready to call it a day.
text.zh-CN: 那罗什福尔呢？他看起来可不打算收工。

text.en: Return to Rose Caravan. I'll meet you there. Keep an eye on Milady, too—she never tells the whole story.
text.zh-CN: 回蔷薇商队，我会去找你。也留心米莱狄，她从不把话说全。

text.en: The ledger, Milady. Then every witness comes with me.
text.zh-CN: 米莱狄，交出账册。所有证人也跟我走。

text.en: You want my information and my silence. Such an ambitious shopping list.
text.zh-CN: 既要我的情报，又要我闭嘴。你的购物清单真不客气。

text.en: D'Artagnan, at your service. The courier's out of reach. These travelers are leaving freely, too.
text.zh-CN: 达达尼昂，愿意效劳。信使已经安全离开，这些旅人也要自由离开。

text.en: You're willing to fight beside Milady?
text.zh-CN: 你愿意和米莱狄并肩作战？

text.en: Beside her, yes. With my back to her? Let's not rush things.
text.zh-CN: 并肩，可以。把后背交给她？我们还是慢慢来。

text.en: A temporary truce, then. Do try to survive your suspicions.
text.zh-CN: 那就暂时休战。可别忙着疑心，忘了活下来。

text.en: Enjoy your little alliance. I know how quickly its loyalties can change.
text.zh-CN: 好好享受这点同盟之情吧。我知道，有些人的忠诚变得有多快。

text.en: The caravan can move on, and the courier is free. I'll stay with you. All for one, and one for all!
text.zh-CN: 商队能继续赶路，信使也自由了。我会留下与你同行。人人为我，我为人人！

text.en: I'll take the help. We can argue about trust on the road.
text.zh-CN: 有你帮忙就好。信不信得过，咱们路上再争。

text.en: With Milady along, we'll have plenty to discuss. Take this Drifting Cloud Sword Manual. There's more to learn together.
text.zh-CN: 米莱狄在，肯定不愁没话说。拿上这本流云剑术手册，我们能一起练的还多。

text.en: Halt! Official ferry toll. Very official. We've made a sign.
text.zh-CN: 站住！正式渡口收费。非常正式，我们还写了牌子。

text.en: I held the sign while it dried.
text.zh-CN: 牌子晾干时，是我负责扶着的。

text.en: Impressive credentials. Who appointed you?
text.zh-CN: 资历真不错。谁任命你们的？

text.en: We took a vote. Four in favor.
text.zh-CN: 我们投过票，四票赞成。

text.en: No one opposed. Excellent turnout.
text.zh-CN: 无人反对，投票率很高。

text.en: I'd like to inspect your permit before you inspect my purse.
text.zh-CN: 在你们检查我的钱包之前，我想先检查你们的许可。

text.en: Plenty of luggage, no toll permit. Our paperwork is flawless. Our next step is fighting.
text.zh-CN: 行李不少，却没有缴费许可。我们的手续无懈可击，下一步该动手了。

text.en: Your permit appears to have expired.
text.zh-CN: 你们的许可，好像过期了。

text.en: A temporary administrative setback!
text.zh-CN: 只是暂时的行政挫折！

text.en: I told you we needed a larger sign.
text.zh-CN: 早说了，牌子得做大一点。

text.en: Four grown men charging travelers for a river they don't own. How enterprising.
text.zh-CN: 四个大人，替不属于自己的河收费。真会做生意。

text.en: Blue Fairy! This traveler wants the paired seals!
text.zh-CN: 蓝仙女！这位旅人想抢那对印记！

text.en: I wanted a receipt. The story seems to be growing.
text.zh-CN: 我只是想要张收据，事情怎么越传越大？

text.en: The seals stay with us. You can argue with my wooden sword.
text.zh-CN: 印记得留下。想讲道理，可以先问我的木剑。

text.en: Pinocchio, be careful. We still don't know this traveler.
text.zh-CN: 匹诺曹，小心些，我们还不认识这位旅人。

text.en: You've made your point. If it's the paired seals you want, let Pinocchio be.
text.zh-CN: 你已经证明本事了。如果你要的是这对印记，别再伤害匹诺曹。

text.en: Keep them. I came for the ferry, not somebody else's keepsake.
text.zh-CN: 你们留着吧。我是来坐船的，不是来抢别人的纪念物。

text.en: Then perhaps we should have started with introductions.
text.zh-CN: 那么，我们也许该先自我介绍。

text.en: Pinocchio. These seals are supposed to make their keeper unbeatable.
text.zh-CN: 我叫匹诺曹。听说这对印记，能让持有者天下无敌。

text.en: We've just conducted a fairly thorough test of that claim.
text.zh-CN: 刚才那场，算是相当充分的实测了。

text.en: Together they say, 'Kindness outlasts force.' Oh. That may explain the results.
text.zh-CN: 合起来写的是：善意胜过蛮力。哦，难怪刚才会那样。

text.en: A lesson worth keeping, even without a trophy.
text.zh-CN: 即使没有战利品，这课也值得记住。

text.en: Captain Orlando, royal collector. Hand over the seals.
text.zh-CN: 皇家征收官，奥兰多队长。交出印记。

text.en: You may have them. They don't do what you think.
text.zh-CN: 可以给你，它们没有你想的那种本事。

text.en: Then I'll take the witnesses, too.
text.zh-CN: 那证人也一并带走。

text.en: Ah. Another permit problem.
text.zh-CN: 啊，又是一桩手续问题。

text.en: We need to regroup. This invitation is closed. We can try again from an earlier save, with a better plan.
text.zh-CN: 得先整备了。这次邀请已经关闭；要再试，得读回之前的存档，重新准备。

text.en: You can have the seals. The travelers are going free.
text.zh-CN: 印记可以拿走，旅人们得自由离开。

text.en: Thank you. Pinocchio has quite enough to learn without a royal cell.
text.zh-CN: 谢谢。匹诺曹要学的事已经够多了，用不着再去牢房进修。

text.en: Let me come with you! I'll be useful. Usually. And when I'm not, I'll try.
text.zh-CN: 让我跟你们走吧！我能帮上忙。通常都能。帮不上时，我也会努力。

text.en: Not my finest crossing. I'll prepare before trying the ferry again.
text.zh-CN: 这回渡河不太漂亮。准备好了再来。

text.en: I'll claim the secret. A matched set ought to be worth something.
text.zh-CN: 秘密归我。这么配套的东西，总该值点什么。

text.en: Those seals? The Wizard mentioned their secret once. He got as far as 'Pearl.'
text.zh-CN: 那对印记？魔法师提过它们的秘密，只说到了珍珠。

text.en: Pearl what?
text.zh-CN: 珍珠什么？

text.en: That's where he stopped. For a man with so many answers, he does leave a lot unfinished.
text.zh-CN: 他说到这儿就停了。知道那么多答案的人，也真能留悬念。

text.en: Then we'd better look for Snowmelt Town.
text.zh-CN: 那么，就去融雪镇找找。

text.en: There's an old cave near Snowmelt Town. Very dark. Excellent echoes.
text.zh-CN: 融雪镇附近有座老洞窟。很黑，回声特别好。

text.en: Show me the entrance? I'll leave the echo testing to you.
text.zh-CN: 能带我去入口吗？测试回声的工作，就交给你。

text.en: Deal. The cave never interrupts.
text.zh-CN: 成交。洞窟从不打断人说话。

text.en: A long slot, then a short one. The paired seals turn the light into a trail.
text.zh-CN: 先是一道长槽，再是一道短槽。合用这对印记，光就指明了路。

text.en: There. A chest. At last, a riddle with a handle.
text.zh-CN: 在那儿，一口箱子。总算碰上一个带把手的谜语。

text.en: A playbook and a small fortune. A very practical secret.
text.zh-CN: 一本手册，还有一笔钱。这秘密倒很实用。

text.en: A letter from Grimm?
text.zh-CN: 格林的信？

text.en: Come see me.
text.zh-CN: 回来见我。

text.en: Concise. He must be saving ink for the stories.
text.zh-CN: 真简短。他一定把墨水留给故事了。

text.en: Field note: visiting Grimm advances the world story. Some unfinished encounters may close permanently. Finish what matters to you and save before returning.
text.zh-CN: 旅途提示：回访格林会推进世界剧情，一些未完成的事件可能永久关闭。先完成你在意的路线，返回前记得保存。

description.en: Storymarket's stalls sell supplies for the road. Check what each potion restores before buying.
description.zh-CN: 故事集市的摊铺供应旅途物资。购买前先看清药剂恢复生命、能量，还是两者。

description.en: Rochefort's guards hold a courier here. D'Artagnan has business with them.
description.zh-CN: 罗什福尔的卫兵在此关押一名信使。达达尼昂有事找他们。

description.en: Shops and stalls. Head here for travel supplies.
description.zh-CN: 店铺与摊贩集中于此，可购买旅途补给。

description.en: Townhouses and a music hall, with stories of their own.
description.zh-CN: 宅邸与琴舍坐落于此，另有各自的故事。

description.en: The edge of Storymarket, with roads toward the countryside.
description.zh-CN: 故事集市的边缘，道路通往城外。

description.en: A guarded tower with an imprisoned courier.
description.zh-CN: 关押着信使的守卫塔楼。

description.en: A nearby hall on another story route.
description.zh-CN: 附近的会馆，另有一段故事。

description.en: The rescue encounter has a 50% chance while its original story window remains open.
description.zh-CN: 原剧情窗口内，营救事件每次有50%概率出现。

description.en: In battle, when a male ally and a female ally both have Bonded Hearts, both gain a random 20%–100% bonus to attack and defense.
description.zh-CN: 战场上己方一男一女同时拥有同心羁绊时，两人的攻击与防御获得随机20%至100%加成。

六和塔营救文泰来。.en: Freed the courier at the Cardinal's Tower.

detail.en: Milady and D'Artagnan can travel with you, for different reasons. The rescue awarded Petalstorm Fist and Riverflow Mastery manuals; the camp finale awarded Drifting Cloud Sword and raised its training cap by 2. Equip and train each ally separately. The ledger stays in the story; it is not an inventory reward. The courier does not join.
detail.zh-CN: 米莱狄与达达尼昂各有所图，都可与你同行。救援奖励落英拳与河流专精手册；营地决战奖励流云剑术手册，并使其研习上限提高2级。请分别为伙伴穿装备、安排研习。账册只参与剧情，不是背包奖励；信使不会入队。

any: 书剑恩仇录_庖丁解牛胜

detail.en: Prepare Milady in Gear & study. For a defensive build, study the Riverflow Mastery Manual and equip the learned mastery separately. Team Practice uses slots 1–2. The finale requires your hero, Milady, and D'Artagnan, who joins just before combat; other companions cannot replace them. Restock and save before visiting Rose Caravan; defeat ends the journey. The world emergency closes this scene.
detail.zh-CN: 先在装备与研习中选择米莱狄。防御培养可选河流专精手册研习，再另行装备已学专精；结伴练习只用前两位队员。决战指定主角、米莱狄与战前才加入的达达尼昂，其他伙伴无法替代。造访蔷薇商队前补给并保存，落败会结束旅程；世界紧急事件会关闭本场景。

blockedDetail.en: The world emergency has already closed this original story window. A prior save is needed to revisit it.
blockedDetail.zh-CN: 世界紧急事件已关闭原本的剧情窗口，需使用之前的存档重访。

detail.en: Prepare your party and save first; defeat ends the journey. Your first three members fight Rochefort and twelve guards. D'Artagnan is not in this battle. In Canalward, enter the Cardinal's Tower and talk to the guard. If the tower is quiet, leave and retry (50% chance). The Mysterious Swordsman milestone closes this window.
detail.zh-CN: 先整备队伍并保存，落败会结束旅程。塔楼由队伍前三位对抗罗什福尔与十二名守卫，达达尼昂此时不参战。到运河镇进入枢机塔，再和守卫交谈；若未触发，请离开重访，概率仍为50%。神秘剑客里程碑之后，救援窗口会关闭。

blockedDetail.en: The Mysterious Swordsman milestone has already closed the rescue window.
blockedDetail.zh-CN: 神秘剑客里程碑已经关闭救援窗口。

any: 书剑恩仇录_回族部落霍青桐

detail.en: Save before visiting Rose Caravan. Only you and Milady fight the five guards here; your traveling companions sit this one out. She has information Rochefort wants—and plans of her own. Winning recruits her and grants the Threefold Swordplay Manual. Begin before the Mysterious Swordsman milestone.
detail.zh-CN: 造访蔷薇商队前先保存。初战只有你与米莱狄对抗五名守卫，同行伙伴不会出场。她握着罗什福尔想要的情报，也有自己的盘算。获胜后她会加入，并赠送三段剑术手册。须在神秘剑客里程碑之前开始。

blockedDetail.en: That original recruitment window is closed in this save.
blockedDetail.zh-CN: 此存档中的原招募窗口已关闭。

nightReady.en: It is nighttime. The opening has no random chance gate.
nightReady.zh-CN: 当前是夜间，开场没有额外随机概率。

nightWaiting.en: Visit from 9 p.m. through 7 a.m. Travel advances time; menus do not.
nightWaiting.zh-CN: 请在21点至次日7点间造访。旅行推进时间，打开菜单不会。

detail.en: You refused the seals, defeated Orlando, and recruited Pinocchio. Refusing the seals added 3 Morality; winning the final fight added 3 more. The Blue Fairy stays a story ally; she does not join. Select Pinocchio in Party to equip and train him.
detail.zh-CN: 你拒收双印记、击败奥兰多，招募了匹诺曹。拒收印记加3点道德，终战获胜再加3点。蓝仙女是剧情盟友，不会入队。到队伍中选择匹诺曹，为他穿戴装备并安排研习。

detail.en: The Scarecrow branch is complete: Survivor's Playbook, 5,000 silver, and +3 to the Paired Cleavers training cap. This is a different reward path; Pinocchio does not join on it.
detail.zh-CN: 稻草人分支已完成：获得生存者指南、5000银币，双刃合击研习上限提高3级。这是另一条奖励路线，匹诺曹不会在此加入。

detail.en: This defeat closes the ferry invitation. If you saved before the encounter, reload the page and choose Load manual save on the title screen, or import your backup from before the ferry. Saving now would overwrite that manual save with this defeat. Continue may load the newer autosave with the loss recorded. Improve your hero before returning; companions cannot join the final fight.
detail.zh-CN: 渡口邀请已因落败关闭。若事件前已手动保存，可刷新页面，在标题页选择读取手动存档，或导入渡口前的备份。现在再保存会用失败进度覆盖原手动档；继续旅程也可能读到记录了落败的较新自动档。先培养主角再来，伙伴不能参加最后一战。

blockedDetail.en: Returning to the ferry will not reopen this invitation in the current save.
blockedDetail.zh-CN: 当前存档中，再到渡口也不会重开这次邀请。

detail.en: With the Scarecrow in your active party, ask the child in Snowmelt Town about the cave. This branch leads to the Playbook reward, not Pinocchio's recruitment.
detail.zh-CN: 带上参战队伍中的稻草人，到融雪镇向孩子打听洞窟。此分支通往指南奖励，不会招募匹诺曹。

detail.en: You kept the seals. Their secret requires the Scarecrow in your active party; talk to him at the tavern. The seals are story props, not newly granted inventory items.
detail.zh-CN: 你留下了双印记。解密需要参战队伍中有稻草人，再去酒楼找他交谈。双印记是剧情道具，原路线并未新发放背包物品。

title.en: Meet the travelers at Windsong Ferry

detail.en: Prepare and save before setting out at night. Three fights run without a map break; Health and Energy carry over. The first two use your first three party members. The finale is your hero ALONE against Orlando and six guards. Refuse the seals (+3 Morality) to protect Pinocchio, or keep them (-3) for the Scarecrow route. Stock up at West Market Supplies. A solo defeat closes this invitation; retry from an earlier manual save.
detail.zh-CN: 夜间出发前先准备并保存。三场战斗连续进行，中途不回地图，生命与能量会延续。前两战用队伍前三位，终战只有主角独战奥兰多与六名守卫。拒收印记（道德+3）保护匹诺曹；收下（道德-3）进入稻草人路线。可先去西市补给铺整备。单人战落败会关闭邀请，重试须读取更早的手动档。

detail.en: You recovered Kai's Frontier Cleave Pages and a Last-Light Remedy. The pages teach up to Rank 5; inspect their requirements in Party → Kai → Study. Getting the pages does not automatically train him. This completes the missing-pages quest, not the whole Denmark story.
detail.zh-CN: 你找回了凯的边境重斩残页，并获得一份余光灵药。残页可教至5级；到队伍→凯→研习查看要求。获得教材并不等于已经替他培养。这只完成缺页笔记任务，不是丹麦全章。

detail.en: Kai has joined. Save before visiting the Apothecary's Hut. Your hero and Kai fight together; a loss or timeout ends this journey. Win to recover his missing Frontier Cleave Pages and a Last-Light Remedy. This is the next step, not the whole Denmark story.
detail.zh-CN: 凯已加入。前往药师小舍前先保存。本场主角和凯共同出战，失败或超时会结束旅程。获胜后找回边境重斩残页，并获得余光灵药。这是下一步，不是丹麦全章。

detail.en: Kai hasn't joined. Check your equipment, mastery and live skill costs before another friendly match. Only your hero fights; companions cannot take their place. Make a manual save before setting out.
detail.zh-CN: 凯尚未加入。再次切磋前检查装备、主专精和实时招式消耗。只有主角出战，伙伴不能代替。出发前先手动保存。

blockedDetail.en: This invitation closed after you discussed Grimm's first letter with him. Other stories remain available.
blockedDetail.zh-CN: 和格林谈过第一封来信后，这次邀请已经结束。仍可探索其他故事。

detail.en: Kai is working on an ice puzzle and some incomplete fighting notes. Save before visiting his cottage: a friendly match uses your hero ALONE. Win and he can join the search for two missing pages. Visit before discussing Grimm's first letter with him.
detail.zh-CN: 凯正在摆弄冰片谜题和不完整的战技笔记。拜访小屋前先保存，友好切磋只有主角出战。获胜后，他会加入寻找两页笔记的旅程。请在和格林谈起第一封来信前拜访。

blockedDetail.en: The invitation has ended in this journey. Other stories remain available.
blockedDetail.zh-CN: 本次旅程中的邀请已结束，仍可探索其他故事。
